Hackathon project

Can RSI improve an LLM's understanding of physics?

Background

Advanced LLMs can now generate videos that look physically real.

The problem

But the motion often breaks the physics.

Newton's laws

A ball drifts sideways with no force.

Example violations, each flagged by a check.

Our idea

Put an agent in the improvement loop.

Model draws
the scene
→
Agent finds
failures
→
Agent writes data,
verifiable reward
→
Train with RL
on that reward
  • The agent, a stronger model (Claude), builds the training environment.
  • It generates the data and writes a verifiable reward: a program checks the physics.
  • It fine-tunes the model with that reward as the RL signal, and keeps exploring.
